Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

birdnetR (development version)

birdnetR 1.0 is a breaking release. It wraps version 1.5 of the Python birdnet package (0.3.2 used 0.1.7) and loads BirdNET+ V3.0 by default. All functions have new birdnet_<verb> names. The old functions are removed without a deprecation cycle; the table below maps them to the new ones.

Upgrading from birdnetR 0.x

0.3.2 1.0.0
birdnet_model_tflite(version = "v2.4") birdnet_load(version = "2.4", backend = "tf")
birdnet_model_protobuf(version = "v2.4") birdnet_load(version = "2.4", backend = "pb")
birdnet_model_meta(version = "v2.4") birdnet_load(type = "geo", version = "2.4")
birdnet_model_custom(classifier_folder, classifier_name) birdnet_load_custom(model = "<folder>/<name>.tflite", species_list = "<folder>/<name>_Labels.txt")
predict_species_from_audio_file(model, audio_file) birdnet_predict(model, files = audio_file), then as.data.frame()
predict_species_at_location_and_time(model, latitude, longitude, week) birdnet_predict(model, latitude = , longitude = , week = ), then as.data.frame()
labels_path(model), read_labels(species_file) birdnet_list_species(model); read your own list file with readLines()
available_languages(version) birdnet_list_languages(version)
get_top_prediction() Removed; use dplyr::slice_max() or birdnetTools
install_arrow() Removed; not needed

Arguments of the model loaders:

0.3.2 1.0.0
tflite_num_threads (birdnet_model_tflite(), birdnet_model_meta(), birdnet_model_custom()) Removed. Each model runs on one thread per worker; set n_workers in birdnet_predict() or birdnet_encode() for parallelism.
custom_device (birdnet_model_protobuf()) Removed from the loader; pass device = "CPU" or "GPU" to birdnet_predict() or birdnet_encode(). See birdnet_use_gpu().

Arguments of the acoustic prediction function:

0.3.2 predict_species_from_audio_file() 1.0.0 birdnet_predict()
audio_file (one file) files (one or more files)
chunk_overlap_s overlap
filter_species species_list
use_bandpass Removed; set bandpass_fmin / bandpass_fmax
keep_empty (default TRUE) Removed; segments without detections give no rows, see below
use_arrow Removed

Output columns now follow the Python package exactly:

Result 0.3.2 1.0.0
acoustic start, end, scientific_name, common_name, confidence input, start_time, end_time, species_name, confidence
geo label, confidence species_name, confidence

For BirdNET models, species_name is "<scientific name>_<common name>".

Breaking changes

  • Requires R >= 4.1 and reticulate >= 1.47.
  • Requires the Python package birdnet >= 1.5 (< 2) and Python 3.11 to 3.13. reticulate installs both on first use, as before.
  • birdnet_load() loads BirdNET+ V3.0 by default. Use version = "2.4" for the model 0.3.2 used. Versions are written "2.4" and "3.0", without the v.
  • birdnet_predict() returns a result object instead of a data frame. Convert it with as.data.frame() or write it to a file with birdnet_write().
  • Segments without detections no longer produce a row. 0.3.2 defaulted to keep_empty = TRUE and returned a row with NA species and confidence for each such segment; 1.0 returns only actual detections, so row counts and per-file counts change. A recording without any detection gives a data frame with 0 rows.
  • birdnet_predict() returns at most top_k = 5 species per segment by default. 0.3.2 returned every species above min_confidence; use top_k = NULL for that.
  • apply_sigmoid and sigmoid_sensitivity default to NULL, which means each model uses its own default.
  • Loading the Protobuf model on macOS no longer installs tensorflow-metal. Use birdnet_use_gpu("pb") for GPU support.

New features

  • BirdNET+ V3.0 acoustic and geo models. They run on ONNX Runtime, which is part of the default installation on every platform.
  • birdnet_load() gains precision ("fp32", "fp16", "int8") and library (the TFLite interpreter: LiteRT or TensorFlow’s own).
  • birdnet_load_perch() loads Google’s Perch v2 acoustic model (not supported on Intel Macs).
  • birdnet_encode() returns embeddings (one vector per audio segment).
  • birdnet_load_custom() loads classifiers trained with BirdNET-Analyzer on the 2.4 or 3.0 base model. version = "auto" reads the base version from a TFLite file. birdnet_inspect_custom() describes a TFLite classifier without loading it. Raven exports of custom classifiers load with backend = "pb" and is_raven = TRUE: scores span the full 0 to 1 range (the sigmoid is applied once), species names come from the label file without its id column, and birdnet_encode() does not work with them.
  • Smaller default installation: it contains ONNX Runtime and LiteRT only. TensorFlow (for Perch, backend = "pb" and Raven exports) and PyTorch (for backend = "pt") are installed automatically the first time a model needs them.
  • birdnet_list_models() lists every model combination the installed Python package can load. Its needs column tells which ones download TensorFlow or PyTorch.
  • birdnet_list_languages() and birdnet_list_species() list the languages of common names and the classes of a loaded model.
  • birdnet_predict() for acoustic models accepts several files at once and gains top_k, min_confidence_custom, apply_softmax, segment_size_s (3.0 only), device, progress, and settings for speed and memory (n_workers, n_producers, prefetch_ratio, speed, half_precision, max_audio_duration_min). Settings left at NULL use the Python defaults.
  • birdnet_predict() for geo models gains year_round_aggregation (how weekly scores are combined when week = NULL), half_precision and device.
  • birdnet_write() writes predictions and embeddings straight from Python to CSV, Parquet or NumPy (.npz) files.
  • The environment variable BIRDNETR_BIRDNET_VERSION pins the version of the birdnet Python package, for example "==1.5.0".
  • birdnet_sitrep() reports the Python version and path, the birdnet version and the installed runtimes. Include its output in bug reports.
  • birdnet_use_gpu() sets up GPU support (PyTorch on Linux, TensorFlow on Linux and Apple silicon). device = "GPU" in birdnet_load_perch(), birdnet_predict() and birdnet_encode() uses it, with one worker per GPU unless you set n_workers.
  • Loading a model prints one line naming the model, backend, precision and number of classes. print() on a model shows the same line.

Bug fixes

  • birdnetR no longer overwrites RETICULATE_PYTHON. If you point it at your own Python environment, birdnetR uses that environment.
  • Integer arguments such as top_k and bandpass_fmin accept whole numbers like 5 as well as 5L.
  • A recording without detections gives a data frame with 0 rows and the usual columns.

birdnetR 0.3.2

CRAN release: 2025-04-30

  • Removes defunct and deprected functions init_model() and install_birdnet().
  • Includes some minor changes to take CRAN Reviewer comments into account.

birdnetR 0.3.1

Major changes

  • use recticulate::py_require() to resolve python dependencies in an ephemeral virtual environment
  • refactors tests to use a hybrid approach of unit tests and mocking without the birdnet python package, and full integration tests that depend on the birdnet python package. See tests/TEST_PLAN.md for more details.
  • initial CRAN release preparations

Defunctions

  • install_birdnet() is now a defunctioned. It is no longer needed to install the birdnet python package manually. The package will be installed automatically when you use it for the first time.

birdnetR 0.2.2

  • updates birdnet Python package to 0.1.7.
  • Fixes #21: unable to initialize model
  • Added a check if audio file is mono

birdnetR 0.2.1

  • install the TensorFlow Metal Plugin for GPU support on Apple devices #25
  • optionally use Apache Arrow to improve performance by reducing memory usage during data conversion and minimizing data copying between R and Python. #26

birdnetR 0.2.0

This update brings significant changes and improvements, including support for loading pre-existing and custom-trained models, aligning the package with birdnet 0.1.6.

breaking changes:
  • The init_model() function is now deprecated and will be removed in the next version. Please use the birdnet_model_* function family for model initialization.
  • available_languages() update: A new argument has been added to available_languages() to specify the BirdNET version, making it more flexible for different model versions.
  • Renaming get_labels_path to labels_path(). It now requires a model object as its first argument.
  • predict_species() was renamed to predict_species_from_audio_file()
  • predict_species_at_location_and_time() was changed to requirer a model object as first argument.
New features:
  • Support for Custom Models: You can now load custom-trained models
  • A new set of functions (birdnet_model_*) to load pre-existing and custom-trained models. These functions offer a more flexible approach to model loading. See ?birdnet_model_load for more details.
  • S3 Object-Oriented System: The models are now implemented as S3 classes, and most of the functionality related to these models is provided through methods. This update makes the API cleaner and more consistent, and allows for better extensibility in future versions.

birdnetR 0.1.2

Uses birdnet v0.1.6 under the hood to fix an issue when downloading models. No new functionality has yet been implemented.

birdnetR 0.1.1

The update of birdnet to 0.1.1 brings:
- Add parameter ‘chunk_overlap_s’ to define overlapping between chunks
- Remove parameter ‘file_splitting_duration_s’ instead load files in 3s chunks
- Remove ‘librosa’ dependency

Other:
- check of the correct version of birdnet is installed in the current virtual environment
- expand vignette on how to use virtual environments
